order: Add a narrow carve-out to the guard hook so the Director may write its own plan files directly instead of routing every plan write through an executor. Scope the carve-out to Write, Edit, and MultiEdit calls targeting markdown files inside the project's plans directory; resolve the target path and verify containment so a parent-directory traversal cannot escape it, and require the .md extension so the carve-out cannot smuggle arbitrary code writes. Let projects extend the allowed locations through a new config key of path-pattern regexes, additive to the default directory; keep those patterns from matching any path outside the project, and parse them with the same fail-open rules as the existing config keys. Update the default deny message to name this exception, so a blocked Director can see exactly where plans may go. Update the docs and installer notes to match, and leave the existing pause-file exemption exactly as it is.
claims: Verified with a 19-case smoke harness: the default carve-out for nested and relative paths and for each write operation, denial of every non-markdown and traversal attempt, presence and absence of the deny hint, the pause-file exemption left unaffected, model stand-down behavior, and allow/deny/outside-project handling for the pattern config, plus fail-safe behavior on a broken config. All 19 cases passed; docs and installer notes were updated to match.
